quote_clock_interpretation: Each quote has ISO8601 UTC Z as_of distinct from receive time. Official OpenAPI documents the field name/type but not whether it is bookmaker-originated versus feed ingestion/other upstream timestamp; therefore do not call it a confirmed official bookmaker publication clock.
